Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB185.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fushi. Fushi Tongxian owns the retained deployment: asked in his question-and-answer column how one who sat through seven broken cushions without seeing the matter could suddenly awaken at a single roll of the curtain, answers with the line alone, then verses that having lost the very man between sitting and lying, seven cushions broken still benighted, had the curtain not rolled at the season's arrival the truth could never have shown itself.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB190.xml). Dharma Platform of Chan Master Shiyu. Senses.Explanation: The promise masters lean on at furnace-openings and year-ends, that the truth needs no pushing, only the season's arrival. Gulin Qingmao opens the winter furnace with the line and lets it stand alone, the sun not waiting for fire to be hot, the moon not waiting for wind to be cool, the world a fathom wide and the old mirror a fathom wide and the furnace a fathom wide, buddha big and mud many, the boat high and the water risen, Fushi Tongxian, asked how one who sat through seven broken cushions without seeing the matter could suddenly awaken at one roll of the curtain, answers with the line and verses that having lost the very man between sitting and lying, seven cushions broken still benighted, had the curtain not rolled at the season's arrival the truth could never have shown itself, Ruibai Mingxue, in his appeal to a patron for a ruined mountain, ranges the old cases, the frog-croak hearers and the osmanthus pointers, the loyal prince who served the state teacher and built twenty-seven temples, all season-and-cause, the thousand acres granted and the ten-thousand monks fed and the six hundred cells built like a heaven-palace, season-and-cause, and the day the fields fell to the mighty and the cells turned to rubble, season-and-cause too, and Tianyin Yuanxiu at the year's end warns that to take it as a season-meeting betrays the old monk's staff and not to take it so buries the hearers' own selves, then stamps the staff, one firecracker sound seeing the old year over and a few plum blossoms opening in the spring valley. Tian'an Sheng at evening instruction turns the line on the mouthers, that those who simply say when the season arrives the truth shows itself belong sent quick to the open outskirts, for old Danxia burned the wooden buddha and the prior's beard and brows all fell off, the thing handed down from past to present, so catch it in a glance or the wooden buddhas stay for Danxia's fire, Yushan Shangsi holds that the great way unbound shows at every touch, one dust one world, one leaf one flower one universe, melting pot and bowl, ring and bracelet into one gold, stirring curds, butter and ghee into one taste, and so with three springs past and the ninth summer just begun, the shading summer trees fully show the durable dharma-body and the dim water-fields forever extend the long life of wisdom, unchanging past ancient and present and hedged by no fence to the world's end, and Shiyu Mingfang at the flower-feast, holding that everyone bears the other half yet asks blankly when questioned, with even the three-times buddhas unable to manage it, grants the old worth one side-line only, the paired line itself, then demands of the assembly what the self-showing truth is and calls for one free spirit to come out and weigh it.
